findings.title: Clean checkout changed OOF metadata bytes and broke formal pool construction
findings.taskbook_clause: All formal assets must be path/bytes/SHA bound and portable to a clean checkout.
findings.expected: A fresh Git checkout contains the exact registered OOF bytes.
findings.observed_before: Registry expected 1,076-byte CRLF bytes while a clean checkout produced 1,049-byte LF bytes; both supported suites had three asset errors.
findings.fix: Canonicalized the immutable OOF metadata representation and updated byte/SHA bindings with a clean-worktree regression test.
findings.observed_after: Python 3.11 and 3.12 full v4 suites both pass 395 tests from the clean review worktree.

findings.title: Post-rename publication failure could leave an unreceipted complete generation
findings.taskbook_clause: A failed generation must not look canonical and must be quarantined or deterministically reconciled.
findings.expected: A failure before receipt publication leaves no orphan canonical generation and preserves the previous pointer.
findings.observed_before: A .complete directory could survive without a receipt, index or recovery pointer.
findings.fix: Added post-rename quarantine plus post-receipt secondary-metadata reconciliation; prior canonical evidence remains append-only.
findings.observed_after: Injected failures after rename, after receipt and before pointer publication all preserve a recoverable canonical prefix.

findings.title: Formal authorization was repeatable because a signed release nonce was not consumed
findings.taskbook_clause: A duplicate formal job must fail before trainer construction and must not be bypassable by copying local state.
findings.expected: Exactly one claimant wins for each signed job token, including concurrent and restarted attempts.
findings.observed_before: The same signed release could be verified repeatedly; there was no atomic one-use job claim.
findings.fix: Introduced signed per-job execution tokens, O_EXCL one-use claims, immutable snapshots and an owner-provisioned shared-root binding that rejects cloned registries.
findings.observed_after: Duplicate, concurrent, corrupt, copied-root and job-substitution cases fail before trainer creation.

findings.title: Frozen exact zero-overlap R2 specification is mathematically infeasible
findings.taskbook_clause: R2 must have 3,000 unique IDs, zero T overlap and exact label/dynamic/fold/oof_group quotas; matching may not silently relax.
findings.expected: All 959 joint strata have enough zero-overlap candidates for a 3,000-ID R2 pool.
findings.impact_scope: The formal eight-arm matrix cannot be instantiated. This is a scientific specification/data-support contradiction, not a matcher code defect.
findings.required_fix: Research owner must sign and hash-freeze an addendum. The audited recommendation keeps 3,000 unique IDs and zero overlap, matches label/dynamic/fold exactly, and uses minimum oof_group displacement for the unavoidable 378 occurrences; this changes the estimand and is not auto-approved.

findings.title: Clean-worktree v3 regression count differs from the old review-plan count
findings.taskbook_clause: Historical regression skips must be explicitly accounted; this mismatch does not independently reject v4.
findings.expected: The prior review plan said 183 passed, 1 skipped.
findings.observed: 181 passed, 3 skipped; one skip needs the registered Desktop mirror and two need 21 local literature-anchor source files.
findings.impact_scope: Historical evidence-profile drift only; protected v3 source has zero content changes and the suite exits zero.
findings.required_fix: Optionally freeze a machine-readable v3 external-evidence test profile. Not required to accept v4 code quality.

findings.title: Formal asset identity did not prove physical image bytes
findings.taskbook_clause: Wrong-file, same-name substitution must be detected before formal dataset iteration.
findings.expected: Every registered image is bound by path, bytes and SHA, not only filename/label.
findings.observed_before: Manifest identity alone could not distinguish a physical-byte substitution at the same path.
findings.fix: Added a 384,000-row Zstd Parquet content ledger and full physical validation.

findings.title: Cleanup failure could hide the primary epoch failure or skip quarantine
findings.taskbook_clause: OOM/NaN/kill/disk failure must preserve the root cause and attempt all cleanup paths.
findings.expected: Primary failure remains raised; recorder and transaction cleanup are both attempted and cleanup errors are attached as notes.
findings.observed_before: One cleanup exception could prevent the next cleanup action or replace the actual training failure.
findings.fix: Centralized best-effort cleanup while preserving the primary exception.
findings.observed_after: Injected telemetry and quarantine failures are both recorded without losing the root failure.

findings.title: Training machine could start a formal job without byte-bound proof that the operator understood the experiment
findings.taskbook_clause: A training-machine AI must know the scientific intent, exact job identity, forbidden actions and success/failure semantics before token claim and trainer construction.
findings.expected: Formal parent/branch entry rejects missing, stale, false, substituted or drifted acknowledgement before data iteration.
findings.observed_before: Documentation existed, but execution did not require a fresh byte-bound acknowledgement tied to the exact job and runbook.
findings.fix: Added a 23-field context, 16 mandatory understanding statements, seven-day freshness, immutable snapshots and closeout validation.
findings.observed_after: Formal runners validate the acknowledgement before token claim/trainer construction; false or drifted context fails closed.

findings.title: Engineering canary confused vectorized event count with occurrence-row count
findings.taskbook_clause: Canary must prove base/replay occurrence accounting without inventing scientific evidence.
findings.expected: Two vectorized events expand to five occurrence rows: four BASE plus one REPLAY.
findings.observed_before: The canary asserted event cardinality as though each sample generated one event.
findings.fix: Separated vectorized sink events from occurrence-level Parquet rows.
findings.observed_after: Real canary reports base_occurrences=4, replay_occurrences=1, optimizer_step_count=1 and ema_update_count=1.

findings.title: Engineering canary did not fail closed on malformed prediction/frontier outputs
findings.taskbook_clause: A green canary must validate its own Parquet, checkpoint, prediction and 96-point frontier outputs.
findings.expected: Missing or invalid evaluation output makes the canary fail.
findings.observed_before: Mechanics could report PASS without validating every endpoint invariant.
findings.fix: Added output identity, Zstd Parquet, 96-point frontier and recovery validation.
findings.observed_after: The final real canary validates 5 occurrence rows, 4 predictions, 96 frontier rows and independent threshold semantics.

findings.title: Resolved Windows junction paths could be double-prefixed into an invalid extended UNC path
findings.taskbook_clause: Registered long paths must survive atomic write, Parquet publication, quarantine and complete canary validation on Windows.
findings.expected: An already extended path remains extended once and is accepted by the full synthetic canary.
findings.observed_before: Path.resolve() could yield //?/C:/..., which was prefixed again as an invalid UNC path.
findings.fix: Recognize extended syntax both before and after resolve; never add a second prefix.
findings.observed_after: All five Windows long-path tests pass, including a complete canary beyond MAX_PATH.

findings.title: Repository audit rejected legitimate registered v4 preregistration evidence
findings.taskbook_clause: The audit must allow only the exact v4 preregistration namespace and reject neighboring unapproved experiment artifacts.
findings.expected: Exact v4 assets/addenda are allowed; v5 or neighboring paths fail.
findings.observed_before: The newly registered dataset ledger/addendum made the audit fail despite being in the approved experiment directory.
findings.fix: Added only the exact 03_preregistration_v4_sctsr prefix and a negative neighboring-path test.
findings.observed_after: Repository audit passes the registered v4 scope and still rejects unapproved neighboring namespaces.

findings.title: Fresh-checkout mtime was incorrectly treated as protected-history content identity
findings.taskbook_clause: Protected historical code and artifacts must be proven unchanged by content identity; checkout time is not content identity.
findings.expected: Identical baseline/source Git blobs and normalized worktree blobs pass regardless of checkout mtime.
findings.observed_before: A clean worktree created after implementation start looked modified solely because Git does not preserve mtimes.
findings.fix: Bound baseline/source blob OIDs, blob SHAs and normalized worktree OID; retained mtime only as INFORMATIONAL_NOT_CONTENT_IDENTITY.
findings.observed_after: Protected-history content audit passes and the protected-tree diff is byte-empty.
